patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports the recent appearance of several brown, greasy, seemingly superficial lesions on his forehead. He mentions they appeared a few weeks ago and has not noticed any recent changes in size or color. He attempted to scrape them off, assuming they were dirt or a smear, but they persisted. No itching or pain is associated with the lesions.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Hypertension, controlled with medication. No history of skin cancer or chronic skin diseases.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Retired school teacher. Non-smoker. Enjoys gardening and spends time outdoors.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies weight loss, fever, night sweats, or any recent illnesses.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with skin lesions on the forehead.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m a 77-year-old man, and a few weeks ago I noticed several brown, greasy-looking patches on my forehead. I tried to scrape them off thinking it was something on the surface, but they wouldn’t come off, and there’s no itching or pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—such as twitching, jerking, shaking, or uncontrollable movements that you can’t stop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any twitching, jerking, shaking, or any involuntary movements that I can’t stop.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt and feels like it moves a bit when you touch it**? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast, and I don’t feel anything there that moves when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently touch around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, when you gently press around my belly button area, it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”
